name: Body to Body
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of saliva or blood from each of your targets)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature touched/3 levels
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You create a link between you and your targets that functions as shield other, except that (in addition to affecting multiple targets) you may also have any spell that you cast on yourself affect your target creatures as well. All targets must be within range of you, but they do not have to be within range of each other.
